state_ownership.javascript: Each runtime owns one DeviceContext captured through QuickJS function data. Desktop and web register it in SubsystemRegistry; Android destroys it from the managed driver shutdown. Cleanup releases keepScreenOn before the VM is destroyed.
state_ownership.lua: Each runtime owns one DeviceContext captured through a Lua closure upvalue. Desktop and web register it in SubsystemRegistry; Android destroys it from the managed driver shutdown. Cleanup releases keepScreenOn before the VM is destroyed.
state_ownership.wasmtime: WasmCanvasContext owns one DeviceContext passed as the host callback environment and destroys it during context teardown. Cleanup releases keepScreenOn before the store is destroyed.

typescript.description: Device-level controls owned by the current application runtime.

operations.name: keep_screen_on
operations.typescript_description: Request that the screen stays on, or release this application's request. Returns false when the platform cannot apply the change.

operations.name: set_clipboard_text
operations.typescript_description: Copy UTF-8 text to the system clipboard. Returns false when the platform refuses. On the web, the browser may require a recent user gesture.

operations.name: get_clipboard_text
operations.typescript_description: Read the clipboard text, or null when it holds none. On the web, browsers only expose the clipboard asynchronously, so this returns the last text copied, cut, or pasted on the page.

operations.name: haptic
operations.typescript_description: Play haptic feedback (default "light"). Returns false where the device has no haptics (desktop). Throws RangeError on an unknown kind.

operations.name: get_preferences
operations.typescript_description: Read the user's system preferences: dark mode, reduced motion, high contrast, text scale, safe-area insets, and the on-screen keyboard's height, in physical pixels. Cheap to call every frame.

operations.name: set_cursor
operations.typescript_description: Set the mouse cursor shape using CSS cursor names (default "default"). Returns false where there is no mouse cursor. Throws RangeError on an unknown name.
